description: This is a Java class named PartyHelper that provides utility methods for retrieving and formatting party-related names from entity objects within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to obtain party names based on various input parameters and handles entity-specific formatting.

classes.name: PartyHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling party names and related formatting within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getPartyName
methods.description: Retrieves the party name given a GenericValue object representing a party or a Delegator and party ID. Provides options to format the name with last name first.

methods.name: formatPartyNameObject
methods.description: Formats the party name based on the entity's model fields, supporting last name first or normal order, and incorporating group name if present.
